test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the idiom that can best substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

Shelley __ignored__ her father’s wish of studying arts and instead took admission in commerce.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3) i.e. **Bid defiance to.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined part of the sentence illustrates a situation where Shelley acts against her father's wishes.
 
• The idiom **"bid defiance to" **means to resist or disobey openly; to defy. खुलकर विरोध करना 
 
 
• **Example**: The young activist bid defiance to the outdated norms of her society.
